verdict.rationale: The README documents adding skills from the Library in Settings and says every model sees the same skills and tools, so the agent can be equipped with skills. It does not show that developers can author or import their own custom skills rather than pick from a provided library. missing for 10: documentation of authoring or importing custom skills, skill format/structure details, examples of specialized-task skills, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Add skills and MCP servers from the Library in Settings. Every model sees the same skills and tools.
